name: semgrep

files.devbox.json:
{
  "$schema": "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jetify-com/devbox/0.16.0/.schema/devbox.schema.json",
  "packages": [
    "python@3.12",
    "uv@latest",
    "ruff@0.16.10",
    "mypy@2.1.0",
    "pip-audit@2.10.1",
    "detect-secrets@1.5.0",
    "trivy@0.74.0",
    "git@latest",
    "gh@latest"
  ],
  "shell": {
    "init_hook": [
      "uv sync --all-extras 2>/dev/null || true"
    ],
    "scripts": {
      "test": "SMOKE_BASE_URL= uv run python -m pytest tests/ -p scripts.smoke_pytest --cov=todo_api --cov-report=term-missing",
      "test-fast": "SMOKE_BASE_URL= uv run python -m pytest tests/ -p scripts.smoke_pytest --tb=short -q",
      "smoke": "bash scripts/smoke.sh",
      "spec-check": "bash scripts/spec-check.sh",
      "lint": "uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .",
      "lint-fix": "uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format .",
      "format": "uv run ruff format .",
      "typecheck": "uv run mypy .",
      "quality": "devbox run lint && devbox run typecheck",
      "audit": "uv run pip-audit",
      "secrets-scan": "git ls-files -z ':!*.lock' | xargs -0 detect-secrets-hook --baseline .secrets.baseline.json --disable-filter detect_secrets.filters.gibberish.should_exclude_secret",
      "secrets-baseline": "grep -qs is_line_allowlisted .secrets.baseline.json || detect-secrets scan --exclude-files '\\.lock$' --disable-filter detect_secrets.filters.gibberish.should_exclude_secret > .secrets.baseline.json; detect-secrets scan --baseline .secrets.baseline.json --exclude-files '\\.lock$' --disable-filter detect_secrets.filters.gibberish.should_exclude_secret",
      "bandit": "uv run bandit -r src/ -q",
      "security": "devbox run audit && devbox run secrets-scan && devbox run bandit && uv run semgrep scan --config p/python --error",
      "deps-findings": "bash scripts/deps.sh findings",
      "deps-bump": "bash scripts/deps.sh bump",
      "ci": "devbox run quality && devbox run test && devbox run security && if grep -qs '\"ci-extra\"[[:space:]]*:' devbox.json; then devbox run ci-extra; fi",
      "image-build": "docker build -t todo-api:scan .",
      "image-scan": "trivy image --severity CRITICAL,HIGH --format table todo-api:scan"
    }
  }
}

note: security also runs semgrep scan --config p/python --error; existing gates unchanged; needs network for the registry rules
